working

tag_line: Tag the one who is 'on a call' at the kopitiam.

items.Yang Wood: Standing desk by the window. Plant on it, of course.
items.Yin Wood: Works from the sofa, the bed, the balcony. All before 10am.
items.Yang Fire: Camera always on. Ring light since day one.
items.Yin Fire: Desk lamp angled just so. Deep work till dinner.
items.Yang Earth: Same desk, same chair, same 9am. Back to the wall.
items.Yin Earth: Snack drawer for the whole household. Lunch for all.
items.Yang Metal: Door closed. Clock on the wall. Done by 6 sharp.
items.Yin Metal: Cleared the desk before logging in. Every morning.
items.Yang Water: Laptop at the kopitiam. 'Change of scene.'
items.Yin Water: Mutes the call, hears everything in the house.
